prompts.panel_style: STYLE: bright anime cel art, bold clean outlines, flat two-tone shading, saturated colors, richly painted backgrounds.

p01.scene: SCENE: a small student kitchen at night, one empty pizza box open on the counter. SUBJECT: Maya points furiously at the empty box; Ido stands behind her with sauce on his sleeve, looking at the ceiling.

p02s.scene: SCENE: a selfie-style video call frame. SUBJECT: Ido, close-up, sweating, fake smile, a pizza crust visible in the corner of the frame.

animate.base: Bring this still to life as it is: same art style, palette and layout, every face and outfit unchanged. Nothing written on screen, nobody new, one continuous shot.

S01.motion: [0-3s] The woman in the red bomber jacket points at the empty box and talks, outraged. [3-5s] The tall man in the green hoodie slowly hides his sleeve behind his back.
